ratings.scale: Subjective holistic scores for observed emulated mobile interaction: 0 unusable, 5 playable with substantial friction, 7 good with clear friction, 9 excellent with minor friction, 10 exceptional. Wins and HUD scores are not quality grades. Overall is a judgment, not a numerical average.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent, completable mission with helpful touch assistance and atmospheric presentation; repeated manual patrol tracking failures materially limit confidence in mobile combat.
reasons.controls: Large labeled controls, touch aim, scene swipe and reload all acted visibly. Simultaneous MOVE/FIRE drag repeatedly lost target and opening bursts reported COVER/NO IMPACT; this is observed friction, not a proven implementation defect. Continuous rearming is unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery-to-coils-to-upload provides clear progression. Coil vulnerability and OFF feedback were satisfying to understand. Mostly assisted travel and brief combat do not establish sustained challenge or enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Consistent teal/amber visual language, rain, lit station and restrained terminal panel communicate atmosphere; software rendering limits visual fidelity judgment.
reasons.usability: Objective labels, route/approach affordances, progress slots, threat direction and upload instruction helped completion. Reload required an extra tray step; map overview was understandable but small.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo and key objective text clear; smaller signs, compact map, dark enemies and multiple overlapping HUD regions made tracking harder.

coverage.manualMoveFireDrag: Opening guard twice and visible perimeter patrol once; simultaneous left MOVE and right FIRE drag. COVER then NO IMPACT at guard; patrol target left view; no confirmed manual patrol hit or kill. Ammo spent; corrections did not establish success.
coverage.sceneTurn: Scene swipe changed heading 081 to 127; visible TURN threat cue also sampled.
coverage.boss: Reload via TOOLS; targeted coil bursts visibly disabled III, II, I.
coverage.assistance: Held visible ROUTE/APPROACH to collect three memories and reach uplink.

coverage.sceneTurn: Visible TURN CHARGE cue sampled; scene swipe specifically sampled in attempt one, not repeated here.
coverage.planningMap: Opened MAP; inspected overview, selected Mara, 26m route and legend; closed with visible #close-map. No route selection changed.
coverage.tools: Opened TOOLS and selected visible RELOAD in same batch; ammo 6 to 30.

helpful: Planning map explicitly showed selected receiver and walking distance
Coil OFF markers and changing objective confirmed progress

No continuous combat comfort inference from released short batches

ratings.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 10 exceptional and consistently effortless within observed scope. Holistic judgment, not an arithmetic result or outcome grade.

reasons.overall_mobile: A coherent, atmospheric short mission with strong contextual navigation and clear objective progression; manual moving patrol combat remained less reliable to interpret than assisted travel and close coil interactions. Two wins do not alone establish quality or enjoyment.
reasons.controls: Large reachable labeled touch controls, successful entry tap/fire and scene swipe, simultaneous MOVE/FIRE drag actually sampled. Patrol tracking required corrections and lacked immediate confirmation; continued held-burst rearming comfort cannot be judged because capture releases contacts.
reasons.gameplay: Three recoveries, armor/open coil cycle and pressured deck upload provided understandable progression and distinct tasks. Patrol encounters introduced damage and correction attempts. Assisted travel dominated mission completion, so independent navigation/combat depth and sustained enjoyment are not established.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive teal/amber industrial rain scene, weapon silhouette, signage, memory-saved cards and polished terminal panel. Audio and physical performance unassessed.
reasons.usability: Contextual HOLD ROUTE/APPROACH/RECOVER, threat direction cue, paused planning map and explicit upload prompt were helpful. Route could recover from combat detour. Numbered boss markers initially invited an ineffective distant burst.
reasons.readability: Health, ammunition, objective, OPEN/ARMORED and segmented OFF indicators were clear at 390x844. Distant patrols and vulnerable coil details were small against dark architecture; scene text can be tiny.

coverage.patrol: Two manual MOVE plus FIRE drag attempts at visible patrol contacts; no immediate kill confirmation; rear threat cue used twice to reacquire. Misses/uncertain hits preserved.
coverage.boss: First distant marker burst NO IMPACT; corrected taps on exposed coils produced III OFF, II OFF, then final coil disabled; automatic reload sampled
coverage.map: Opened planning map and visibly closed it
coverage.route: Assisted route and approach for three memories and deck
coverage.uplink: Waited on deck, took shield damage, fired at visible attacker before terminal

helpful: Contextual route/approach labels and memory-saved confirmation

helpful: Route recovered navigation after manual combat detour
Close exposed coils and OFF feedback made boss progress legible
frustrating: Moving patrol repeatedly left view during manual combat
Small scene contacts difficult to track confidently
Damage while trying to correct target; shield reached 22 during patrol sample
uncertainties: Individual patrol hits/eliminations not established by immediate captures; terminal aggregate reports 7 eliminations and 100% accuracy

Screenshot at attempt2-deck-fire shows shield 34 while pre-capture UI metadata reports 47; capture timing can straddle live change. Screenshot treated as visible evidence; no internal explanation inferred.
